h1: Window cleaning in Estates Above Hurst Harbor
intro: Estates Above Hurst Harbor is a small group of newer custom homes off Hurst Creek Road. CleanzATX handles these homes with care, since each has its own glass and its own details.

sections.h2: What Estates Above Hurst Harbor homes are like
paragraphs: This is a small custom enclave, and resales are rare. Homes are newer, and prices start from $2M. There is no gate and no HOA listed, so owners decide on upkeep themselves. Hurst Creek Road gives access, and the area feels private because the street count is small.

Custom homes differ more than production builds. One house may have a tall entry with transom glass, and the next may have a wall of sliding doors. Because the community is so small, we often learn the home layouts and remember what each owner prefers.

sections.h2: What Estates Above Hurst Harbor windows deal with
paragraphs: Newer custom homes often use bigger panes and thicker glass with coatings. Those coatings call for careful cleaning, since harsh products or scrapers can damage them. Pure water with no soap suits coated glass well. Nearby water means humidity and mineral spray in some conditions, and sprinkler overspray leaves white spots on lower panes.

Pollen is heavy at the usual times, cedar from December to February and live oak from March to April. Trees around the lots drop leaf bits in screens and tracks. Afternoon sun on western glass shows streaks. We dry to a clear finish, and hard water removal is $10 per pane for older spots.

sections.h2: How we work Estates Above Hurst Harbor
paragraphs: We contact owners ahead of time to cover any driveway or gate specifics. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so no ladders touch finished stone or siding. Inside, we clean by hand, using drop cloths and cotton covered ladders for two story rooms. Many owners add a soft wash for stone and stucco and a hand cleaned patio. We keep the visit quiet, and Tyler is your direct contact.

For a 5,000 square foot home, exterior windows are about $500, with roughly four to five hours on site outside. Windows done on both sides come to $15 each. Triannual plans take 15% off and include a free yearly screen cleaning.

faq.q: Do you clean coated or tinted glass?
faq.a: Yes. We use pure water and soft tools, which suit coated and tinted glass. Tell us if you know of a special coating, and we avoid scraping the surface.

faq.q: How do you protect stone and finishes?
faq.a: Poles and water fed brushes avoid contact with stone. Limestone is soft washed, never pressure washed, and we use drop cloths inside.
Our minimum job is $200. Large custom homes pass that easily, since exterior windows run about $0.10 per square foot.

faq.q: Can you handle tall entry windows?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories. For interior tall glass, we use cotton covered ladders and drop cloths.
